title: Norite Gateway Events
description: Source-of-truth WS dispatch payload contract (see docs/architecture.md §2). M0 skeleton — only the envelope shape is defined; no real op-codes or DISPATCH event types exist yet. This file updates in the same commit as any new gateway dispatch type (CLAUDE.md rule 6), starting at Milestone M18.

op.description: Op-code. See docs/architecture.md §2 for the full table (0 Dispatch, 7 Reconnect, 9 Invalid Session, 10 Hello, 11 Heartbeat ACK server-side; 1 Heartbeat, 2 Identify, 3 Presence Update, 4 Voice State Update, 6 Resume, 8 Request Guild Members client-side).

d.description: Op-code-specific payload. Shape defined per dispatch type starting at Milestone M18.

s.description: Sequence number, present on Dispatch frames only.

t.description: Dispatch event type name, present on Dispatch frames only.
